name: OmniPiano
summary: 一至五只仿真灵巧手协同弹琴的控制任务与环境。
summaryEn: Control tasks and environments for one to five simulated dexterous hands playing piano.
scale: See publisher release and split documentation
scaleZh: 规模与分割以发布方文档为准
access: Official environment/training interfaces; some score assets require separate registration
accessZh: 官方环境与训练接口；部分曲谱资产需单独注册获取
license: Consult publisher terms; data license not independently verified
licenseZh: 请核对发布方条款；数据许可尚未独立核实
wmNote: 作为交互生成环境收录；音乐资产另有访问限制，不代表已采集的真实钢琴动作数据。
wmNoteEn: Included as an interactive generation environment; music assets have separate access restrictions and this is not recorded real-piano motion data.

evidence.locator: Benchmark tracks; Quick start; Gymnasium step; data prerequisites
evidence.statement: The official environment exposes reset and action-conditioned step APIs returning observations, rewards and termination, with robot safety costs and multi-agent variants. It can generate physical-control trajectories without relying on a model-only release.
